title: Pharmaceutical water technical notes | Aquemi
meta: Answer-first notes on USP <1231>, Ph. Eur. 12.3, EU GMP Annex 1, ASME BPE, CSA Z314 and ASTM D1193 for PW, WFI and pure steam. Get each one by email.
eyebrow: TECHNICAL NOTES · STANDARDS · DESIGN · QUALIFICATION · TROUBLESHOOTING
headline: Water system questions, answered in the first three sentences
lead: Short technical notes for engineering, validation and quality assurance (QA) teams who run Purified Water (PW), Water for Injection (WFI) and pure steam systems. Each note answers one question first, names the standard and the edition it rests on, and links to the page where we apply it. Below is our editorial plan: the notes we are writing, grouped by topic, each with the question it answers. None is published yet. Subscribe and we email each note when it is.

blocks.h: Why these notes, and how to use them
body: Most questions about a water system come back to one clause: where USP <645> takes its conductivity reading, what EU GMP Annex 1 6.10 asks of WFI storage, how ASME BPE measures a dead leg. The answers are scattered across monographs, guidance and inspection findings, and they change with each edition. These notes put each answer on one page, with the clause and the number, so your team can check it against the source in minutes.

Every note is written by a named Aquemi engineer from a question we are asked on projects, and each one supports a page on this site where we apply the answer to a real design. A note is our reading of the standard, not a substitute for it: cite the standard in your own documents, and use the note to find the clause.

rows: USP <645> stage 1: why the reading must be non-compensated
Our transmitters show temperature-compensated conductivity. Can we release water on that reading?
USP <1231> is informational. What does it actually ask of you?
Is USP <1231> binding, and where do the 100 CFU/mL and 10 CFU/100 mL action levels come from?
No water system is USP certified
A supplier says its system is "USP certified". What does compliance rest on instead?
Can WFI be made without distillation for Europe, and who must be told before you start?
EN 285 steam quality for a Canadian plant
EN 285 is a European sterilizer standard. Does it apply to us, and what do non-condensable gases, dryness and superheat measure?
Dead legs: how ASME BPE measures L/D
Which L/D should a loop be designed to, and where is L measured from?
Our specification asks for 3.1B certificates. What should we ask for now, and how is it tied to the tube?
CSA B51 and the CRN for imported equipment
Does an imported still or pure steam generator need a Canadian registration number (CRN), and who applies?
CSA Z314 water for hospital reprocessing
What water quality does a medical device reprocessing department (MDRD) need under CSA Z314, and how does ANSI/AAMI ST108 compare?
ASTM D1193 Types I to IV for laboratories
Which ASTM D1193 type does our laboratory need, and how is it different from USP Purified Water?

blocks.h: Design notes: the decisions behind a system
rows: We do not yet know whether we need a still or a membrane system. What decides it?
Does a WFI loop have to be hot, and what does an ambient loop need instead?
Ozone or hot water sanitization for a PW loop
Which sanitization method suits an ambient PW loop, and how do you prove no ozone reaches the point of use?
Single or double pass reverse osmosis (RO) for USP PW
When is a second RO pass worth it ahead of electrodeionization (EDI)?
Why choose EDI over mixed-bed resin, and when does resin still make sense?
Our supply is chloraminated. Is standard carbon enough, and where does the ammonia go?
USP <1231>; Guidelines for Canadian Drinking Water Quality
Cold feed water and RO output in a Canadian winter
How much RO output do we lose at winter feed temperatures, and how is a system sized for it?
Design practice (no limit set by a standard)
How big should the generator be compared with the tank, for our peak draw?
Questions to ask when comparing water system proposals
Two proposals look alike on price. Which scope, document and test differences matter?
What factory acceptance test (FAT) results can replace in IQ and OQ
Will our quality unit accept FAT results in place of installation and operational qualification (IQ and OQ) tests?
Is DQ the supplier's job or ours, and what does the quality unit approve?
Do we really have to wait a year before using the water?
Alert and action levels from qualification data
Why not use the pharmacopoeia limits as alert levels, and how are they set?
We are adding points of use or replacing a PLC. Must the whole system be requalified?
21 CFR Part 11 and Annex 11 on a water system
Is a water system's control system Part 11 compliant, and where does the boundary with the plant historian sit?
How often does an online total organic carbon (TOC) analyzer need system suitability, and against what?
Why is my RO producing less water?
Permeate flow has dropped. Is it temperature, fouling or scaling, and what do we check first?
Loop conductivity is trending up but still in limits. Where does it come from, and when do we act?
A TOC excursion on an online analyzer
TOC spiked on one reading. Is it the water, the analyzer or the sample line?
Why do counts after the carbon bed jump, and how is the bed controlled without chemical carryover to the RO?
Cleaning no longer restores flow or rejection. How do we decide to clean again or replace?
Microbial counts at one point of use only
One outlet fails and the rest pass. Is it the loop, the valve, the hose or the sampling?
EU GMP Annex 1 6.13; FDA Guide to Inspections of High Purity Water Systems
Rouge in a hot WFI system
We see rouge on the tank and loop. Is it a quality risk, and when is derouging worth it?
The sterilizer fails the dryness test
Our autoclave fails the EN 285 dryness test. Is it the generator, the header or the test?
Ph. Eur. 12.3: what changed for water
What did the 12.3 revisions of Purified Water (0008), WFI (0169) and TOC (2.2.44) change, in force 1 July 2026, and does any of it touch an existing system?
EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) for water and steam
Which Annex 1 clauses apply to WFI, pure steam and distribution, and how does Health Canada's GUI-0119 apply them?
FDA computer software assurance (CSA) guidance and water system controls
The CSA guidance was finalized in 2025 and revised in 2026. What does it change in how we test the controls?
What would the revised Annex 11 change for audit trails and periodic review on a water system, once final?
ASME BPE editions: naming one in your specification
A new ASME BPE edition is out mid-project. Which edition applies, and what must be assessed?
The FDA QMSR and device makers' water systems
The Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR) took effect on 2 February 2026. What changed for our rinse water system?

items.q: Can we cite a note in our validation documents?
items.a: Cite the standard, not the note. A note is our reading of the clause, with the clause number so you can check it. Your quality unit decides how the standard applies to your site.

items.q: What happens when a standard changes after a note is published?
items.a: We review the note against the new text, update it, and change its date of last review. If the answer changes, the note says what changed and when, and subscribers to that topic get the update.
Aquemi engineers who work on the systems the notes describe, named on each note with their role. [Named author for each topic group]
